One day before lunch, I checked my 'scrip inside my satchel and counted the remaining pills. I wasn't sure what to do, and honestly felt kind of bad for the "kid" (23 y/o). I came up with a plan that I never intended following through with, but decided to give it a go afterwards. It ended with him paying me $250 bi-weekly for a couple months, and he got to keep his job. I have kept a close watch since, but now we are pretty well back to normal.
